This '''bird''' was an [[Bird/Legends|avian]] that lived on the [[Panna Prime|Mud Moon of Panna]]. The animal had blue feathers, a long, thin beak, large and pale bulbous eyes, and long, thin legs nearly equal in length to its body, from beak to tail tip.

The [[Bird/Legends|bird]] [[Species/Legends|species]] fed at waterways and walked through the garbage heaps outside of [[Panna City]]. One specimen witnessed the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] leave the city on a [[Paar's ichthyodont]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], being pursued by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol on a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].
